content: {"episode_id": "ep-05004", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "CO-197", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness and to address the patient's history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction."}
